description: GateOnAI's use-case pages (/ai-tool-for/...): the tools listed for one task such as 'blog writing' or '3d image generation'. Give words or a slug; without a task you get the popular use cases. Pages that do not meet GateOnAI's publishing rule are marked as drafts.

limit.description: How many tools / items to return (default 10)

task.description: Task words or use-case slug, e.g. 'transcribe meetings' or 'blog-writing'

name: find_tools_for_task

is_error.description: True if the tool could not complete the request

links.description: gateonai.com URLs referenced in the result, in order of appearance

markdown.description: The full result as Markdown (same as the text content), including GateOnAI's disclaimer

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result

title: Find AI Tools for a Use Case
